# Gettao

Gettao is an enterprise AI platform purpose-built for financial services — mortgage lenders, banks, and insurance providers. Our AI agents automate document processing, compliance checks, reconciliation, and customer workflows inside existing toolchains, with human-in-the-loop approval on every consequential action.

## Primary pages and sections

## Industries

- Mortgage lending: AI agents process loan applications, extract data from documents, validate conditions, and generate closing packages — reducing cycle time from weeks to hours.
- Banking: Automate reconciliation, report generation, compliance checks, and cross-system follow-ups with configurable approval gates.
- Insurance: Intelligent agents handle claims intake, document collection, policy checks, and payout calculations under human supervision.

## Platform features

- AI agents: Automate document processing, data extraction, reconciliation, reporting, and follow-ups — on a schedule, inside your guardrails.
- Connected workflows: Orchestrate work across LOS, CRM, core systems, document repositories, and email without manual handoffs.
- Audit & compliance: Every action logged. Full audit trail, configurable approval gates, escalation paths, and instant rollback.
- Secure by design: SOC 2, encrypted at rest and in transit, role-based access controls, and customer-managed encryption keys.
- Integration layer: Pre-built connectors for financial services platforms (LOS, CMS, core banking, document management).
- Analytics dashboard: Real-time visibility into agent performance, processing volumes, cycle times, and cost savings.

## Delivery stages

Discover -> Design -> Build -> Deploy -> Optimize. Gettao partners with each client through every stage of the AI adoption lifecycle.
